name: gradient-morpheus-den
title: Morpheus Den
description: A decorative vertical gradient block that runs from bright turquoise along the bottom up through blue to a dark indigo top, with soft rounded corners.
use: A cool teal-to-indigo field is wanted behind a hero, card or media block.
avoid: It is static flat colour, and the dark top edge swallows dark text and icons.
a11y: Decorative only: no text, controls or focus, so it carries no information by itself. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle filled by a vertical gradient that starts in vivid turquoise along the bottom edge, passes through blue and settles into a deep indigo at the top. Black margins frame it.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The two colour stops are fixed, but extra classes or inline styles can resize and repaint the block.
customise: The gradient stops are baked into the inline style; pass className or style to resize, round or repaint it, otherwise edit the file.
weight: light: One div with a CSS gradient and no script.
polishWhy: Smooth vertical blend with a clean rounded shape; still a stock two-colour gradient.
